technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with high volume spike present, but severe downtrend structure (price below all MAs, death cross, below cloud) and negative volume profile create high risk; potential bounce play only with tight stops.

fundamental.summary: MMM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 56 days—fundamentals lack bullish catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Market fear (33/100) presents contrarian opportunity, but congressional activity is neutral with mixed small-value trades 61-75 days old; no confirmatory news data available.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (311.68) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinational industrials, and earnings in 56 days adds event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme RSI oversold (9-period) combined with 15x volume spike and ADX trending creates a potential mean-reversion bounce play, especially with price near support at 91.90.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe structural downtrend (price below all major MAs, death cross, below Ichimoku cloud, three black crows) combined with crisis-level VIX, inverted yield curve, negative CMF/OBV, and zero fundamental catalysts make any bounce high-risk and likely to fail.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme oversold RSI and 15x volume spike create technical bounce potential, but severe structural downtrend (death cross, price below all MAs, below cloud) and zero fundamental catalysts make risk/reward unfavorable.
